# Paglora Studio v0.2.0

Desktop release candidate. The npm CLI has its own version.

## Added
- Optional site favicon URL or locally generated 64×64 transparent PNG, with export/preview support.
- Content-addressed `_paglora/chunks/` JavaScript and CSS bundles, with compact `pages/` HTML compatibility mirrors. Existing canonical page filenames stay accessible.
- Optional signed stable Studio updates with release notes, a launch-time prompt and a manual check under Settings.
- Portable .paglora project backups and collision-safe restores, including private drafts.
- Local-first Markdown Studio with website design and public-only static HTML export.
- Translated Studio controls and website navigation in English, Polish and Korean.
- Headless site builder for the official Paglora Docs GitHub Pages workflow.
- Native cards, callouts, code groups, steps, search and appearance controls.

## Improved
- Responsive previews, site themes, dark-mode accents, local assets and publishing reports.
- Shared Rust website renderer for Studio and automated documentation builds.

## Fixed
- Critical Cargo ambiguous executable error preventing bun run desktop.
- Studio autosave escaping [!NOTE], [!CARD] and [!STEPS] markers.
- Card link loss and several localization regressions.

## Deprecated
- None.

## Removed
- None; project data is retained when upgrading.

## Known limitations
- Release candidate only: the modern Windows installer and signed updater integration are being designed separately in `m1nsook/paglora-i`. No stable download should be published before that work and live Windows acceptance tests.
- `pages/` currently contains compatibility mirrors marked `noindex`; root HTML filenames remain canonical until navigation/search/SEO URLs are migrated and tested.
- German, French and Dutch translations proposed in `paglora-lang` PR #11 still need native-language reviewers and contributor CI approval; they are not bundled in the verified EN/PL/KO snapshot.
- Initial Windows installer only; macOS/Linux packaged releases are future work.
- One-click Cloudflare Workers and Vercel deployments are not yet implemented.
- Public npm CLI versioning remains independent from Desktop.
